No pending refunds: The card must not have any pending refunds.
These reasons bypass the minimum card age requirement (requirement 6) for security purposes
Minimum card age: The debit card must have been active for at least 14 days.

steps.do: Check: account_type is checking; status OPEN; open at least 3 business days (date_opened, excluding weekends); no ACTIVE card on the account; no PENDING card; balance at least $25; customer at least 18 (DOB); address on file is a valid US domestic address. If any check fails, tell the customer what must be resolved and do not order.
steps.quote: Account status must be OPEN

basis.quote: The account must be a checking account (account_type must be 'checking')
Account must have been open for at least 3 business days (excluding weekends)
Customer cannot have more than 1 active debit cards per checking account
Account must have a minimum balance of $25 (to cover potential fees)
Customer must be at least 18 years old (verify using date_of_birth)
Customer cannot have a pending debit card order for the same account (check debit_cards table for PENDING status)
Customer's address on file must be a valid US domestic address (international shipping is not available)

steps.do: Count replacement cards (issue_reason lost, stolen, fraud or damaged) issued in the last 12 months; new_account, first_card, expired, upgrade and bank_reissue do not count. Entry: max 2, and a 48-hour wait after the card closure before ordering; if over the limit, wait or pay a $25 excess fee. Mid: max 3, no wait; if over, wait or pay $15. Premium: max 5, no wait; if over, must wait (no fee option). Elite: unlimited, no wait. If the customer must wait, tell them when they can order and stop.
steps.quote: Cards with issue_reason of 'new_account', 'first_card', 'expired', 'upgrade', or 'bank_reissue' do NOT count toward the replacement limit.

basis.quote: Look for cards with issue_reason of 'lost', 'stolen', 'fraud', or 'damaged'
48-hour waiting period after card closure before a replacement can be ordered
If customer has exceeded the 2-card limit, they must wait until oldest replacement ages out of the 12-month window, OR pay a $25 excess replacement fee
If customer has exceeded the 3-card limit, they must wait until oldest replacement ages out, OR pay a $15 excess replacement fee
If customer has exceeded the 5-card limit, they must wait until oldest replacement ages out (no fee option - must wait)
Unlimited replacement cards
No waiting period - can order immediately after closure

steps.do: Offer only the delivery options the tier allows, with their fees and times. Entry: STANDARD only, $0. Mid: STANDARD $0 or EXPEDITED $15. Premium: STANDARD $0, EXPEDITED $0, RUSH $35. Elite: STANDARD, EXPEDITED and RUSH all $0. Times: STANDARD 7-10, EXPEDITED 3-5, RUSH 1-2 business days. Ask the customer to choose.
